idea-plugin.name: pyO3-maturin
idea-plugin.description:
pyO3-maturin adds a Gradle-style side panel for maturin / PyO3 projects.

It detects every folder that contains both Cargo.toml and pyproject.toml as a build task, lets you pick a start Python file, and run or natively debug the compiled Rust module (maturin develop + Python, with one-click attach of RustRover's Rust debugger). It can also create a Python environment with maturin and destroy compiled artifacts.
